title: Compliance Review Timetable for Personal Sender Account Limit Reviews
content:
The decision window of a limit review request on a Personal Sender Account is a whole number of Paloma business days, Monday to Friday excluding US Federal Reserve holidays.

The standard decision window is the compliance review time of the level requested, which is the level directly above the level the account holds: 3 business days when the account holds Paloma Verified Plus and so requests Paloma Enhanced, 5 business days when it holds Paloma Enhanced and so requests Paloma Premier, and 7 business days when it holds Paloma Premier and so requests Paloma Private Client, these being the compliance review times of the levels requested. A request for a level reachable without review carries no compliance review time.

The counted decision window of a request starts from its standard decision window, and the decision window of the request is its counted decision window.

The decision due date of a limit review request is the request date plus the decision window, counted forward in Paloma business days from the request date.

## Timetable

| Level the account holds | Level requested | Standard decision window (Paloma business days) |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Verified Plus | Paloma Enhanced | 3 |
| Paloma Enhanced | Paloma Premier | 5 |
| Paloma Premier | Paloma Private Client | 7 |
| Paloma Starter or Paloma Verified | a level reachable without review | no compliance review time |

## Worked example (hypothetical dates)

An account holding Paloma Enhanced lodges a request for Paloma Premier on a Monday, in a week and the week after with no US Federal Reserve holiday. The decision window is 5 Paloma business days. Counting forward from the Monday: Tuesday is day 1, Wednesday day 2, Thursday day 3, Friday day 4, and the following Monday day 5. The decision due date is the following Monday; Saturday and Sunday are not counted.

Had a US Federal Reserve holiday fallen on that Wednesday, it would not be counted either, and day 5 would fall on the following Tuesday.
